name: 11play-web
description: 11Play production validation and Firebase Firestore Security Rules testing.

scripts.check:js: find js admin scripts -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && if [ -d tests ]; then find tests -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check; fi
scripts.validate: npm run check:js && npm run validate:production && npm run test:rules
